description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this information resource. Coverage is county roads or the specific site named below. Paired line and polygon layers locate assets on Chambers Bay Properties, including the golf course and restaurant, maintained trails and restrooms, sewer-division buildings and parking areas, the environmental-services building and wastewater-treatment plant. The source-defined information supports capacity planning analysis for these infrastructure systems. The two layers share the same described site inventory and LABEL/comment attributes and are grouped as geometry components. These broader property assets are distinct from the preliminary wastewater-treatment-plant building expansion footprints. Individual asset labels and conditions were not read. Access is through public county catalogue entries and ArcGIS REST metadata; GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors are advertised. The licence is not stated. Reuse is subject to linked county GIS terms; the terms PDF was not opened and charges are not stated. A limitation is that metadata review does not establish current operational availability, accuracy or complete attribute coverage. No data export, feature query or application payload was read. A regular update frequency is not stated. Related sources are identified in the record notes where a concrete connection is established.
